lead: Osho was an Indian writer, born on 11 December 1931 in Udaipura.
He died on 19 January 1990 in Pune at the age of 58.
He has 3 credited works on public record.
The sections that follow break down Osho's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Osho — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Osho was born on 11 December 1931 in Udaipura, and holds citizenship of India, British Raj and Dominion of India. He was given the name चन्द्र मोहन जैन at birth and is publicly known as Osho.
He studied at Dr. Hari Singh Gour University.
He is recorded as speaking English and Hindi.

sections.heading: Osho — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists writer, autobiographer, guru, mystic, religious leader and teacher as his occupations, including work with Rani Durgavati University, Jabalpur.
